categories.name: DDL - Tables
categories.description: Data Definition Language for table operations

templates.name: Create Table
templates.description: Create a new table with primary key
templates.sql:
CREATE TABLE table_name (
    id NUMBER PRIMARY KEY,
    name VARCHAR2(100) NOT NULL,
    created_date DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE,
    status VARCHAR2(20),
    CONSTRAINT chk_status CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE'))
);

templates.name: Add Column
templates.description: Add a new column to existing table
templates.sql:
ALTER TABLE table_name
ADD (column_name VARCHAR2(50) DEFAULT 'default_value' NOT NULL);

templates.name: Drop Column
templates.sql:
ALTER TABLE table_name
DROP COLUMN column_name;

templates.name: Create Index
templates.description: Create an index on table column(s)
templates.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_table_column
ON table_name (column_name);

categories.name: DML - Queries
categories.description: Data Manipulation Language for data operations

templates.name: Basic SELECT
templates.sql:
SELECT *
FROM table_name
WHERE condition = 'value'
ORDER BY column_name;

templates.name: INSERT Single Row
templates.description: Insert a single row into table
templates.sql:
INSERT INTO table_name (column1, column2, column3)
VALUES ('value1', 'value2', 'value3');

templates.name: UPDATE with WHERE
templates.sql:
UPDATE table_name
SET column1 = 'new_value',
    column2 = 'new_value2'
WHERE condition = 'value';

templates.name: DELETE with WHERE
templates.sql:
DELETE FROM table_name
WHERE condition = 'value';

templates.name: JOIN Tables
templates.sql:
SELECT t1.*, t2.column_name
FROM table1 t1
INNER JOIN table2 t2
    ON t1.id = t2.table1_id
WHERE t1.status = 'ACTIVE';

templates.name: Simple Procedure
templates.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE procedure_name (
    p_param1 IN VARCHAR2,
    p_param2 OUT NUMBER
)
AS
BEGIN
    -- Procedure logic here
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO p_param2
    FROM table_name
    WHERE column = p_param1;
EXCEPTION
    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
        p_param2 := 0;
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        RAISE;
END;

List All Tables

templates.name: List Table Columns
templates.description: List columns for a specific table
templates.sql:
SELECT column_name, data_type, data_length, nullable, data_default
FROM user_tab_columns
WHERE table_name = 'TABLE_NAME'
ORDER BY column_id;

templates.name: List Indexes
templates.sql:
SELECT index_name, index_type, uniqueness, status
FROM user_indexes
WHERE table_name = 'TABLE_NAME'
ORDER BY index_name;

templates.name: List Constraints
templates.sql:
SELECT constraint_name, constraint_type, search_condition, status
FROM user_constraints
WHERE table_name = 'TABLE_NAME'
ORDER BY constraint_type, constraint_name;

templates.name: Table Size
templates.sql:
SELECT
    segment_name AS table_name,
    ROUND(bytes/1024/1024, 2) AS size_mb,
    blocks,
    extents
FROM user_segments
WHERE segment_type = 'TABLE'
  AND segment_name = 'TABLE_NAME';

templates.name: List Procedures
templates.sql:
SELECT object_name, status, created, last_ddl_time
FROM user_objects
WHERE object_type = 'PROCEDURE'
ORDER BY object_name;

templates.name: List Functions
templates.sql:
SELECT object_name, status, created, last_ddl_time
FROM user_objects
WHERE object_type = 'FUNCTION'
ORDER BY object_name;

templates.name: List Packages
templates.sql:
SELECT object_name, object_type, status, created, last_ddl_time
FROM user_objects
WHERE object_type IN ('PACKAGE', 'PACKAGE BODY')
ORDER BY object_name, object_type;

templates.name: Invalid Objects
templates.description: List invalid objects that need recompilation
templates.sql:
SELECT object_type, object_name, status
FROM user_objects
WHERE status = 'INVALID'
ORDER BY object_type, object_name;

templates.name: Get Source Code
templates.description: Get source code for stored object
templates.sql:
SELECT text
FROM user_source
WHERE name = 'OBJECT_NAME'
  AND type = 'PACKAGE'
ORDER BY line;

templates.name: Explain Plan
Table Statistics
Active Sessions
templates.sql:
SELECT
    s.sid,
    s.serial#,
    s.username,
    s.status,
    s.program,
    s.sql_id,
    s.last_call_et
FROM v$session s
WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND s.username IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.last_call_et DESC;

templates.name: Date Formatting
templates.sql:
SELECT
    SYSDATE AS current_date,
    TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS iso_date,
    TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') AS full_datetime,
    TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'Day, Month DD, YYYY') AS long_format
FROM dual;

templates.name: String Operations
templates.sql:
SELECT
    UPPER('text') AS uppercase,
    LOWER('TEXT') AS lowercase,
    INITCAP('hello world') AS title_case,
    SUBSTR('abcdefg', 1, 3) AS substring,
    REPLACE('hello world', 'world', 'oracle') AS replaced,
    TRIM('  text  ') AS trimmed,
    LENGTH('text') AS length
FROM dual;

templates.name: NULL Handling
templates.sql:
SELECT
    NVL(column_name, 'default') AS with_default,
    NVL2(column_name, 'not null', 'is null') AS null_check,
    COALESCE(col1, col2, col3, 'default') AS first_non_null,
    NULLIF(col1, col2) AS null_if_equal
FROM table_name;

templates.name: Row Limiting
templates.sql:
-- Oracle 12c+ FETCH FIRST syntax
SELECT *
FROM table_name
ORDER BY column_name
FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;

-- Alternative with ROWNUM
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT *
    FROM table_name
    ORDER BY column_name
)
WHERE ROWNUM <= 10;
